description: How many days did ISA take on average, in its latest published period, to process a residence application for this status of residence? Give status (key, Japanese or English name), optionally procedure. Returns figures with period, blank cells, the PDF's notes, ISA's PDF URL and retrieval time. Status: found, not_listed (blank, not zero), unknown, unreadable_latest (older readable period, labelled). Averages of approved applications, not a forecast.

measure.description: Optional: disposition (days to issuance or notification of permission) or review_end (days to the end of examination; extension and change, from FY2020). Omit for both

procedure.description: Optional: coe (certificate of eligibility), extension (extension of period of stay) or change (change of status of residence). Omit for all

status.description: Status of residence: key (e.g. engineer-humanities-international, student, highly-skilled-professional-1a), Japanese name as in ISA's table (e.g. 留学, 高度専門職1号イ) or English name (e.g. Student). Exact match only; see residence_processing_statuses

name: residence_processing_latest

blank_cells.description: Cells that are blank in ISA's table for this period (no figure; not zero).

days.description: Average number of days as printed by ISA.

measure.description: disposition = days to issuance or notification of permission; review_end = days to the end of examination (extension and change, from FY2020).

procedure.description: coe = certificate of eligibility (issuance); extension = extension of period of stay; change = change of status of residence.

notes_as_published.description: The notes printed under the table in that period's PDF, as published (Japanese).

period.description: Period the figures cover (YYYY-MM months; quarters are fiscal, April-June = Q1).

disclaimer.description: Read first: averages of applications approved in the period, as published by ISA; not a forecast for any individual application.

fixed_notes.description: Notes that apply to every figure (approvals only, what disposition means, blank is not zero, seasonal peaks).

period.description: Period the figures cover (YYYY-MM months; quarters are fiscal, April-June = Q1).

latest_official_period.description: ISA's latest period on the list page and whether this service could read its PDF.

blank_cells.description: Cells that are blank in ISA's table for this period (no figure; not zero).

days.description: Average number of days as printed by ISA.

measure.description: disposition = days to issuance or notification of permission; review_end = days to the end of examination (extension and change, from FY2020).

procedure.description: coe = certificate of eligibility (issuance); extension = extension of period of stay; change = change of status of residence.

notes_as_published.description: The notes printed under the table in that period's PDF, as published (Japanese).

period.description: Period the figures cover (YYYY-MM months; quarters are fiscal, April-June = Q1).

older_readable.description: Only with unreadable_latest: the most recent period this service could read. Older than ISA's latest.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

source.description: Where the answer comes from: ISA's list page and PDF, and when this service read them.

fetched_at.description: When this service downloaded that PDF.

index_checked_at.description: When this service last read ISA's list page successfully.

pdf_url.description: ISA's PDF the figures were read from.

status.description: found = figures in the latest period read; not_listed = blank cells in that period (not zero); unknown = no readable data yet; unreadable_latest = ISA's latest PDF could not be read, older_readable has the most recent readable period (older).

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.
